capabilities: Render tikz and luatikz fenced code blocks
Edit diagrams visually with shapes, circuits, and freehand ink
Export diagrams as SVG or PNG
Assist TikZ editing with autocomplete, linting, and error explanations
extras: Bundled TikZJax runtime enables mobile rendering without a local TeX install; local rendering is opt-in and scoped, with a separate security guide.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to render or visually edit TikZ diagrams, and mobile users cannot rely on a local TeX installation.

relations.evidence: Desktop can use local LuaLaTeX or TikZJax

summary: TikZ renderer and visual editor that renders tikz and luatikz code blocks with local LuaLaTeX or bundled TikZJax, live preview, and SVG/PNG export.
